falsification_conditions.condition: The price of the asset rises by 10% above the current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant upward move would contradict the 'HOLD' signal and suggest a bullish trend, invalidating the UNKNOWN verdict.

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume exceeds 200% of the 14-day average volume
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained extreme volume would indicate strong market participation, refuting the 'HOLD' signal and suggesting a breakout or breakdown scenario.

falsification_conditions.condition: A central bank announces a policy change (e.g., interest rate cut or quantitative easing) within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: An exogenous policy event would introduce a new variable, invalidating the pattern-based UNKNOWN verdict by creating a clear external driver.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
